Rockett Audio Designs Flex Drive Overdrive Touch-sensitive overdrive that responds to picking dynamics with amp-like feel. J. Rockett built the Flex Drive around touch sensitivity, creating an overdrive that responds to your picking dynamics like a well-tuned amp. Dig in for more saturation, back off for clean. The circuit rewards expressive playing. The name reflects the flexibility of the response. It's not a one-setting pedal that sounds the same regardless of how you play. The Flex Drive adapts to your technique, making it useful across multiple musical contexts. Volume, Gain, and Tone provide the controls. The Flex Drive works well as an always-on tone enhancer or a solo boost depending on how you set it. True bypass switching.
